assertion_statuses.PRESENT: The report explicitly describes the entity or finding as present.
assertion_statuses.ABSENT: The report explicitly negates the entity or finding.
assertion_statuses.UNCERTAIN: The report expresses uncertainty or describes a possible finding.
assertion_statuses.HISTORICAL: The report describes a past condition or finding.
assertion_statuses.NOT_SPECIFIED: The entity is mentioned, but its assertion status is not clear.

annotation_rules: Record entity category separately from assertion status.
Do not interpret a mentioned entity as automatically present.
Preserve explicit negation from the source report.
Preserve uncertainty expressed in the source report.
Do not infer assertion status from the entity category alone.
Do not reconstruct text masked by XXXX.
